item.title: Midday: Daddy cool: This podcast highlights the changing role of fathers in modern age
item.description: Our pick for podcast of the week this time is about everyone’s first hero — dad. Like the character sketch of every hero ever written, this one too has learned to walk with time. Most fathers in urban India do not restrict themselves to financially supporting the family anymore; they have evolved into caregivers of their children, too. Stories of such multi-tasking fathers are brought to the fore in the podcast Dadsense with Subhasis Mishra

item.title: Times of India: Papas Who Podcast: How Indian Dads Got Talking About Fatherhood
item.description: When he moved back to India from the US seven years ago, Subhasis Mishra, head of talent acquisition (APAC) at Amazon Entertainment, noticed how the dad’s side of the parenting conversation was completely missing. “In fact, earlier when they planned group activities in my kids’ school in Bengaluru, the parent leader would always be called ‘Class Mom’. Thankfully now there are more ‘Class Dads,” Mishra exclaims.

item.title: Adgully: Podcasting - Part 1: Despite huge opportunity, where India lacks in tapping the potential?
item.description: The podcast industry in India is booming, especially during and after the pandemic. Once a hugely popular medium in the west, especially in the US, podcasting has come of age here, with the proliferation of an army of podcasters all over the country and a steadily growing audience. Since 2016, there has been an exponential growth in the number of podcast listeners in the country.
